en.hubeali:
Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Ali Bin Al Hakam, from Al A’ala Bin Razeyn, from Muhammad Bin Muslim, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup>

having said that the man would be brought on the Day of Judgement, and on him would be the (minimum amount of) blood - of the measurement of a cup, so he would be saying, ‘By Allah<sup>azwj</sup>! I did not kill, nor did I participate in (shedding of his) blood!’ He<sup>azwj</sup> would Say: “Yes (you did)! You mentioned My<sup>azwj</sup> so and so servant, so that led to him being killed, therefore you are responsible for his blood (shedding)”’.
